Disclosure: I worked as a contractor for this company for about eight months in 2023, mostly on the billing system. I no longer have any financial relationship with them, but wanted that on the record before reviewing their product.

With that out of the way: the dashboard is fine. The invoice export still breaks on large date ranges, which was true when I worked there and apparently still is. Support was responsive when I filed a ticket, answered within a day.

I'd recommend it for small teams. I wouldn't recommend it yet for anyone processing more than a few thousand invoices a month.
